Chunk text is the exact body span. Headings remain separate, are recombined for indexing/scoring, and appear in citation display headers. This decides representation and quote provenance, not general semantic heading authority.
RetrievalNomination carries text, section_heading, structural provenance, retrieval diagnostics, and inferred roles. Presence in this schema does not assign all fields semantic support authority.
ep1 item identity includes source hash and span, but does not include heading, text, authority_class, or section_role directly. Separate frozen-file hashes preserve their observed values.
nomination_from_hit copies text and heading from the chunk. section_role is a deterministic heading heuristic; authority_class is an admission/inspection label, not truth or semantic entailment.
G3 checks quote containment in nomination.text, excluding heading from the quoted source span.
G5 allows identifiers from cited metadata including headings. This lexical identifier exception does not authorize heading-derived daily frequency or other propositions.
G6 blocks requirements based only on revision-history/references roles. It does not semantically prove requirements or grant other roles support authority.
